name: May Manoj

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: May Manoj’s ‘Heaven on Earth’ brings its reader into a conversation about the value of an ordinary human life. Short, rhyming stanzas move through laughter, tears and the small acts of care that make a day matter.

The poem’s promise rests in everyday conduct: kindness, humility and forgiveness become ways of making the world more generous. Its direct address gives the verse the warmth of encouragement, asking the reader to recognise a capacity for goodness already close at hand.
